attributes.title: HIC–Yale Masters of Medicine 2027: The Race Against Time
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Masters of Medicine meeting, presented by the Heart Institute of the Caribbean and Yale Cardiovascular Medicine, runs over a weekend at the AC Hotel Kingston in Jamaica. This edition is themed «The Race Against Time» and centres on dementia, longevity and the brain–heart connection, with tracks on cardiovascular science, menopause and human performance.

The Sunday scientific programme includes sessions on healthy ageing, hypertension across the lifespan, early Alzheimer's detection, a debate on intensive cardiovascular prevention after 75, and a cardiovascular point-of-care ultrasound workshop. Two forums on Sunday afternoon are free and open to the public; the Saturday evening gala is by invitation only and not part of registration.

CME credit is listed by the organizer as pending: no credit amount or accrediting body has been published yet. Physicians practising in Jamaica can apply for a preferential rate.
